title: Sonatype Nexus Repository 3 Pro does not check the local account status when a user signs in through a configured SAML…
description: Sonatype Nexus Repository 3 Pro has a vulnerability where it does not verify the local account status when users authenticate via configured SAML or OAuth2/OpenID Connect identity providers. This allows users whose local accounts are disabled or locked to regain access if they have valid credentials at the identity provider, receiving a new session with their assigned roles.
